mentions.name: Xingolak
mentions.description: This tool visualizes how semantics shift into different grammatical structures when translating between Basque and English/Spanish. It uses Stanford NLP to analyze the input text, then feeds that analysis to Claude to generate the data structure needed to render the translation visualization, which uses a ribbon metaphor in the UI (Xingolak is Basque for "ribbons").
mentions.problem: The author, learning Basque, wanted a way to see how semantics move into different grammatical structures when translating between Basque and English/Spanish.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://xingolak.pages.dev/

I've been learning Basque and wanted to see a visualization of how the semantics move into different grammatical structures when translating between Basque and English/Spanish.

Under the hood it's using Stanford NLP to analyze the input then that analysis is given to Claude to generate the data structure needed to visualize the translation.
